processing_steps.duration: 25 min (Fe-27Mn-12Al-0.9C, SIP alloy, Table 4); 1050 °C for Fe-27Mn-11.5Al-0.95C (time not specified)
processing_steps.method: solution treatment (solutionizing) in the single-austenite / two-phase region
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Austenite based duplex steels are solution treated in the temperature range ~900-1100 °C. Specific example: Fe-27Mn-11.5Al-0.95C solution treated at 1050 °C; Fe-27Mn-12Al-0.9C (SIP) solution treated at 1050 °C/25 min.

Fast cooling/water quenching avoids formation of coarse intergranular κ-carbides; the austenite matrix in the solution-treated and water-quenched condition contains SROs (<2 nm) and possibly nano-sized κ'-carbides (20-30 nm).

aliases: γ+δ (triplex) in solution treated and water quenched condition

phases_present.morphology: continuous austenitic matrix; in hot-rolled condition banded with δ stringers
elongated band-like δ-ferrite / δ stringers parallel to the rolling direction; thin strip-like

precipitates.coherency: coherent with the austenite matrix (lattice misfit < 3%)
precipitates.distribution: intragranular, homogeneous within the austenite matrix
precipitates.type: κ'-carbide, (Fe,Mn)3AlCx (metastable, x<1), ordered L'12 / perovskite-type E2_1 (Fe,Mn)3AlC

structures.number_of_phases: 3 (γ austenite matrix, δ-ferrite, κ-carbide) for triplex; γ + δ for duplex
structures.overall_structure: γ + δ-ferrite duplex (triplex) microstructure with the austenitic (γ) phase forming the continuous matrix; at the final stage small amounts of δ-ferrite and intragranular nano-sized κ-carbides are present in the austenite matrix.
